name: TSPLIB
description: TSPLIB is the standard library of instances for the Traveling Salesman Problem and its close variants. It collects symmetric TSP, asymmetric TSP (ATSP), Hamiltonian cycle, sequential ordering (SOP), and capacitated vehicle routing instances, ranging from 14 cities up to 85,900 cities (pla85900). Most instances ship with known optimal or best-known tour lengths, so solvers and heuristics are scored by the optimality gap of the tour they return.
general_score_metric: tour length / optimality gap to best-known
typical_sota_score: Exact solvers (Concorde) and the LKH heuristic reach the known optimum on the vast majority of instances; pla85900 was solved to proven optimality by Concorde.
reputation: The de facto standard benchmark library for the Traveling Salesman Problem; used to validate exact solvers (Concorde) and heuristics (LKH) for over three decades.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark; designed for combinatorial optimization solvers and metaheuristics. Measures solution quality against known optima rather than formulation accuracy. Distributed in the TSPLIB95 format.
